definitions.full: H6196. armon עַרְמוֺן noun [masculine] plane-tree (as stripped of bark); — ׳ע Gen 30:37 (J); plural עַרְמֹנִים Ezek 31:8 . מַעֲרֻמֵּיהֶם 2Chr 28:15 see below II. עור .
